about: Carignan is a city in Montérégie, Quebec, on the Rivière Richelieu south of Montréal between Chambly and Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu. Riverside suburbs, canal heritage nearby, and South Shore farmland toward the Richelieu Valley define the community. About 11,000 people live in Carignan.
seoSummary: Montérégie Richelieu River city south of Montréal between Chambly and Saint-Jean—riverside suburbs and valley farmland.
